gap_classification.notes: Official GIFT IBU page https://www.yes.bank.in/gift-ibu is a JavaScript-only SPA. Re-verified: Playwright render fails with net::ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR and WebFetch times out (>60s). No inline rate table, no rate PDF link, no discoverable XHR rate endpoint. Web search indicates Yes Bank GIFT IBU offers ~4-5% on foreign-currency deposits but no public rate card is published.
